evidence.detail: Client creates rs/q/a/a only in exact menu action 454, passing the three routing integers that the exact-current action matrix identifies as widgetId, slot and itemId for C2S41.

Under the action-454 timing/flag branch, Client appends the value object to a dedicated List instead of writing C2S41 immediately; the class itself stores exactly those three integers and exposes only getters.

A later Client loop path waits for the configured interval, iterates the queued rs/q/a/a values, writes opcode 41 followed by the three stored integers with the exact C2S41 transforms, then clears the queue.

Exact-current protocol authority labels opcode 41 as inventory option 2 / equip alias and warns that its visible meaning is definition/context-driven; the proposed name therefore stops at DeferredInventoryAction rather than asserting Equip or a single option-slot verb.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the delayed C2S41 inventory-action record. It intentionally preserves opcode41's context-dependent semantic boundary.
